usedFor: Cin7 Core holds stock and orders, and Google Docs keeps the record that “Add or Replace Text In Tab” updates.

bestTemplate.name: “When a purchase order is authorised” in Cin7 Core, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: An authorised purchase order is final enough to record, and the action writes it into a Google Docs tab.

watchOut: “When a product's available stock level changes” fires on every change, so one product can write to the tab often.
